verdicts.reason: A suits the wide banner: the headline sits on one line with clear hierarchy and the stack is well centred. Its flaw is the headline running almost edge to edge, with only about 16px of side margin, so it feels jammed against the canvas edges. B keeps the two-line stacked headline from the original, which squeezes the vertical space. The headline is about 15px from the top and the CTA about 14px from the bottom, with wide empty side areas. The subhead and CTA text are shrunk small and hard to read, so B looks like a scaled-down copy rather than a rearranged layout.
